title: Ukrainian: romanization system (UNGEGN Working Group on Romanization Systems)
author: UNGEGN Working Group on Romanization Systems
publisher: United Nations Group of Experts on Geographical Names (archived by the Institute of the Estonian Language)
usedFor: Independent check of the 2010 national transliteration table, including the word-initial forms, gh only in зг, and ь and the apostrophe not romanized. Also used for the system's status (UN Resolution X/9, 2012) and the statement that it is not fully reversible.
